select dept_id, parent_id, ancestors, dept_name, status from sys_dept force index (idx_sys_dept_parent_id) where del_flag = '0' and parent_id in #{parentId} order by dept_id for update
select dept_id from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' for update
